text.nowheel.title: Nowheel
text.nowheel.overrideEntityCulling.toolt: Override Entity Culling's config to cull contraptions that wouldn't get culled by default. Can improve performance in specific scenarios. Requires restart.
text.nowheel.tickCulling.tooltip: Skip the client tick of culled Create machines. Improves performance. Disable if some things are not animated properly.
text.nowheel.distanceCulling.tooltip: Cull stuff that Entity Culling can't trace. Improves performance on render distances 8+.
text.nowheel.forceRemoving.tooltip: Only enable if performance is much lower than on previous versions of Nowheel. Forces the legacy removing backend to be used on indirect Flywheel backends.
